task_description: Fix the four reported agentLens overlay/rendering UX defects in laya-browser-mcp (current main = laya v3): (1) right side of the page not fully rendered (headed window/viewport mismatch in src/browser.ts); (2) synthetic cursor not visible (should be a visible blue cursor moving in real time); (3) streaming feedback popup is top-center and poorly designed (move to bottom-center, raised up, restyle as a modern frosted-glass card); (4) no four-corner highlight (add a persistent blue four-corner bracket frame while Laya controls the browser). Also switch the brand accent from purple (#a855f7) to blue (#3b82f6) as the single source of truth, deriving accent-based shadows instead of hardcoding purple. Preserve the overlay invariant: pointer-events:none, very high z-index, guarded best-effort no-op methods that never change automation semantics. Commit to a feature branch off main; do not push or open a PR.

verification.summary: pnpm run build clean; pnpm typecheck clean; full pnpm test = 247 passed / 3 skipped (only documented webkit/host-lib skips). No Dockerfile in repo, so docker_build skipped. Test quality: overlay tests drive REAL headless Chromium and read the live DOM (banner bottom-anchored + frosted, cursor visible via showCursor, four-corner sessionFrame toggles on/off with blue accent rgb 59,130,246 and every node pointer-events:none), so they exercise the new code and would fail if reverted. Not verifiable in-sandbox (no display server): the actual headed OS-window-fills-viewport fix (issue 1) and live headed visuals; verified by reasoning + the injected client-script content + the fallback test showing --window-size only on the headed attempt.
